subject: A five-minute audience experiment: one page, one sentence
text:
Hi Greg,

I saw Talk Paper Scissors credited to you on Nolen Royalty’s site — a small prompt that gets strangers interacting. That is the part I thought might connect with this idea.

Would you be interested in an unpaid, five-minute audience experiment around Take The Wall? It is one public page with one featured owner, replaced by the next paid takeover.

The segment is simple: ask “What sentence would you put on a page somebody else can take over?”, collect replies, and preview a few of the suggestions. You can do it as a short post or video too. Neither you nor your viewers need to buy anything to suggest messages or use the preview. Publishing a takeover is separate and costs $3.99, with no guaranteed duration or audience.

I prepared the outline, audience prompt and 15-second actual-app clip here:
https://github.com/sariserhan/company-operator/blob/main/marketing/takethewall/creator-collaboration/HOST-PACK.md

Your preview link:
https://takethewall.com/?take=1&utm_source=greg-technology&utm_medium=collaboration&utm_campaign=one_sentence&utm_content=creator_preview

You can reuse the supplied clip, keep your own opinion, and choose the format. If it interests you, a reply with the format you prefer is enough to start. Nothing has been announced in your name.

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
